chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muskān, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man and a woman performing salat (prayer) together in a house, with the woman on the man's right, aligned beside him. He said: No, not until there is between them a handspan, or a cubit, or something similar.

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman praying alongside the man
key_terms.بِحِذَائِهِ: directly parallel or aligned with him
key_terms.ذِرَاعٌ: a cubit as a measure of separation
key_terms.شِبْرٌ: a handspan as a measure of separation
key_terms.عَنْ يَمِينِ الرَّجُلِ: on the right side of the man

ai.seo_question: What distance should there be between a man and a woman praying side by side?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the spacing between a man and a woman when they perform salat (prayer) together in the same place. It indicates that if the woman is praying beside the man, there should be a separating distance such as a handspan, a cubit, or something similar.
